PQ_rules_adopted.sampling: F1: each update draws B=128 caption records IID uniformly WITH replacement (numpy default_rng(seed).integers(0,145000,128)); image of a record = observed map[record]
PQ_rules_adopted.Q: F1: off-diagonal record draw positions, weight 1/(B(B-1)) (U-statistic); same-image (and repeated-record) product pairs are RETAINED, no masking
PQ_rules_adopted.J_BCE: same P/Q weights; J = E_P[T-T^2/2]-E_Q[T+T^2/2] with T=tanh(g/2), no clipping; BCE = E_P softplus(-g)+E_Q softplus(g) (= F1 balanced_logistic on log_ratio=g)
PQ_rules_adopted.NCE: bidirectional CE on the same BxB g, positives = the same observed record diagonal; all other draws are candidates (no duplicate masking, consistent with Q support). Not read from truth.
PQ_rules_adopted.duplicate_counts: per unit: number of repeated-record pairs and same-observed-image off-diagonal pairs over all 2000 batches recorded in RESULT.json batch_stats
PQ_rules_adopted.peers: two R30 H peers: shared critic parameters, per-peer standardization, loss = 0.5*(peerA + peerB) on the same records, eval per peer then mean of g; no cross-peer products

copied_from_F1_actual.D_affine_init: F1 AffineCosineCritic: s=softplus(raw)+1e-6 init 2.0, offset 0.5, both learnable; g=log_ratio=2s(cos-o)
copied_from_F1_actual.D_projection: F1 components=256, linear head with bias per modality (hidden_dim null)

mismatches_vs_old_F1: Encoder: R30 H 40-epoch DEV-best two-peer IN2R host (each condition its own H), not the R32 W2 GPO single-tower parent.
Features: native H embeddings with native per-batch centering + L2 (forward_emb, eval mode); F1 used pointwise encoder outputs without batch centering.
Two peers (shared critic, peer-mean score) vs F1 single model.
Observed map: the H parent's own full-pool map (R25 f30k_precomp_0.6.npy / identity at 0%); F1 used R32 FIT/SELECT role split with its own noise draw. R32 maps not used.
No SELECT pool and no checkpoint selection: fixed step 2000 primary endpoint (F1 selected by SELECT-J, eval_every 100).
DEV J readout uses the record U-statistic (Q off-diagonal records) like training; F1 evaluate() used the image-marginal x uniform-caption V-statistic (diagonal included).
FIT-observed J read on a locked 14,500-record FIT subset (not F1's SELECT pool).
New arms: BCE for the dual-cosine structure (F1 had ratio_logistic only on the simplex critic), InfoNCE (absent in F1), joint MLP X structure (absent in F1). F1 simplex-ratio arms not used.
Device: GPU float32 (F1 ran on CPU float32).
Ranking: upstream IN2R i2t/t2i argsort on the peer-mean g (F1 used its own deterministic-tie retrieval_metrics); tie-bounded (optimistic/pessimistic) recalls reported in addition.
pq_rules.X_structure_choices_not_in_package: activation GELU (as R32 _head hidden layer), torch default Linear init, output scalar g without extra affine
